newsitem.title: UK: Halifax shares to be sold in daily tender.
newsitem.headline: Halifax shares to be sold in daily tender.

text.p: Britain's Halifax Plc said on Wednesday orders had been received to sell about 2.94 million shares at the daily tender, representing about 0.1 percent of the newly-floated firm's share capital.
Halifax said bids would be accepted up to 1700 GMT on Wednesday from pre-registered institutions and London Stock Exchange member firms.
Halifax's shares rose 9.0p to 733.5 by 1330 GMT.
Britain's biggest mortgage lender made its debut on Monday on the London stock market, ranking third among the exchange's biggest listed banks. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
